scenes.title: Private financial work, checked
scenes.narration: A business receives nine hundred dollars covering two invoices. Sealwork helps match those private records and pays the worker only after the agreed checks pass.

scenes.title: A constrained hiring decision
scenes.narration: I ask the hiring agent to choose within my rules. It uses public build history, recommends a reviewed executable, and cannot change my budget or payment destination.

scenes.title: Financial files stay confidential
scenes.narration: I review the fictional invoices and bank records. The bank-analysis path encrypts the private input for NEAR AI Cloud, separately from the public hiring decision.

scenes.title: Combined payments and uncertainty
scenes.narration: The live private model proposes allocating nine hundred dollars across five hundred and four hundred dollar invoices. The ambiguous two hundred fifty dollar payment stays Needs review.

scenes.title: The buyer approves the agreement
scenes.narration: I review the proposed matches and acceptance rules before funding. The model’s suggestion is only a proposal. A separate deterministic verifier will check the original records.

scenes.title: The task fee is separate
scenes.narration: The worker fee is zero point zero five testnet NEAR. It pays for processing; it does not move the fictional bank payment. I approve the pinned-build agreement.

scenes.title: Verified work gets paid
scenes.narration: The worker and separate verifier execute privately through OutLayer. The checks pass, NEAR escrow settles the fee, and the receipt now says Verified and paid.

scenes.title: Inspect the checked delivery
scenes.narration: I can inspect the checked private report. The combined payment matches, and the ambiguous item remains open. The public receipt excludes the plaintext financial records.

scenes.title: Evidence follows exact code
scenes.narration: Both execution records identify the agreed binary fingerprints. NEAR holds the budget, processes authenticated callbacks and records the outcome. Full hardware evidence is linked for inspection.

scenes.title: A public URL does not reveal files
scenes.narration: Opening the same receipt in a separate page shows encrypted delivery. Public visitors can inspect settlement and evidence, but they cannot read the private report.

scenes.title: Recovery restores private access
scenes.narration: Importing the private recovery file restores access to the report. Keep that file private. Its access material is excluded from the repository and this demo evidence.

scenes.title: A faulty update earns its own outcome
scenes.result: Earlier faulty job → rejected and refunded
scenes.narration: Finally, this genuine earlier faulty-build receipt is rejected and refunded. Its failure belongs to that code version. Sealwork combines confidential work, independent checks and conditional NEAR payment.
